headline: NYC proposes AI kill switches and whistleblower rewards
body: A quiet day. New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin proposed bills requiring outside validation and kill switches for AI sold in the city, plus whistleblower rewards and a right to sue over harm from jailbroken systems. Stronger oversight is a small plus for Alignment & Control, nudging Gatekeeper and Protector God up and Conquerors down. Horizon Balance edged up to -9.73.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.1, Protector God +0.1 and Conquerors -0.1, all helped by the NYC proposals (+0.04, +0.05 and -0.05).
